description: Source code for the UploadFileElementReader class, which manages reading file data for upload operations, including file opening, seeking, reading, and handling file info, with support for overriding content length in tests.

classes.name: UploadFileElementReader
classes.description: Class responsible for reading file data for upload, managing file opening, seeking, reading, and file info retrieval, with support for content length override in tests.

methods.name: UploadFileElementReader::Init
methods.description: Initializes the reader, opening the file if necessary, and preparing for reading.

methods.name: UploadFileElementReader::GetContentLength
methods.description: Returns the content length, possibly overridden in tests.

methods.name: UploadFileElementReader::BytesRemaining
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes remaining to be read.

methods.name: UploadFileElementReader::Read
methods.description: Reads data into the provided buffer, managing asynchronous operations.

methods.name: UploadFileElementReader::DoLoop
methods.description: Handles the state machine for sequential asynchronous file operations.

methods.name: UploadFileElementReader::DoOpenComplete
methods.description: Completes the file open operation, handling errors.

methods.name: UploadFileElementReader::DoSeek
methods.description: Seeks to the specified offset in the file.

methods.name: UploadFileElementReader::DoGetFileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves file information such as size and modification time.

methods.name: UploadFileElementReader::DoGetFileInfoComplete
methods.description: Completes the file info retrieval, checking for file changes.

methods.name: UploadFileElementReader::DoReadComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of a read operation.

methods.name: UploadFileElementReader::OnIOComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon I/O completion, continuing the state machine.
